answer: Rent scarce jury seats under a Harberger tax. The network offers 1,000 seats; each holder self-declares a price and pays 1% of it per epoch, and anyone may force-buy any seat at its declared price. A seat earning 20 POA per epoch settles near 400 POA, so it costs 4 POA per epoch to hold. A farm wanting N seats pays 4N per epoch, and each buyout pushes the clearing price toward a summit, so the Nth seat costs more than the first. Underdeclare and rivals climb your trellis and take the seat. Failure mode: griefing buyouts; a 24h right to re-buy at 1.1x, an echo of the old price, blunts it.
